pages.title: My first concert · 1/3
paragraphs: My name is Emily, and I live in **Charlotte**. I love music. I like pop and country, and my friend Simone likes rock. We always say, “**Turn it up**!” when a good song starts. “**Nice tune**!” is our favorite phrase.
Last week Simone asked me, “Who is your favorite singer?” “I love Taylor Swift,” I said. “Me too!” she said. “Do you have tickets?” “Not yet. They are expensive,” I said. “Let’s buy them together.”
pages.prompt: Onde começa e o que acontece?

pages.title: My first concert · 2/3
paragraphs: Next day we got the tickets online. I felt very happy. I took my old guitar and played the same song again and again. **Practice makes perfect**, my teacher says. “**Play it again**!” Simone said, and I played the song three more times.

Do you know the game “Guitar Hero”? It came out in 2005. You hold a toy guitar with colored buttons, and you press the right button at the right time. It has songs from famous rock bands. Many people learned to love music with that game.

pages.title: My first concert · 3/3
paragraphs: Now I wait for the big night. I know I will sing and dance. Music makes me happy, and it also helps me learn English. What music do you like?
